items.name: Himalayan Sunset Textured Art
items.desc:
A peaceful mountain landscape
Capture the beauty of a Himalayan sunset with dramatic mountain peaks, glowing orange skies, and shimmering lake reflections. Rich, expressive brushwork adds depth and warmth, creating a serene focal point for your living room or meditation space.

items.name: Ram Sita Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A devotional watercolor illustration
Celebrate the timeless bond of Lord Ram and Goddess Sita through delicate watercolor washes, vibrant accents, and graceful details. The airy white background gives this devotional artwork a light, elegant presence suited to a prayer room or peaceful corner.

items.name: Sacred Ghats Textured Art
items.desc:
A glowing riverside cityscape
Inspired by the spiritual beauty of India's sacred riverfronts, this artwork features temple silhouettes, boats, and golden reflections beneath a fiery sunset. Layered painterly strokes bring the scene to life with warmth, atmosphere, and depth.

items.name: Coastal Flow Textured Art
items.desc:
A calming abstract composition
Soft ivory tones blend with muted aqua and blue-green shades in this flowing abstract composition. Sculptural surface details evoke the movement of coastal water, bringing a fresh, tranquil feel to contemporary interiors.

items.name: Abstract Geometry Textured Art
items.desc:
Modern geometric abstraction
Neutral tones, bold dark marks, and a striking burgundy accent come together in this contemporary abstract artwork. Its layered forms and distressed-looking details create visual contrast, making it a distinctive addition to modern and minimalist spaces.

items.name: Desert Horizon Textured Art
items.desc:
An earthy abstract landscape
Inspired by open desert horizons, this artwork combines sandy neutrals, terracotta shades, and muted charcoal mountain forms. Its layered, expressive surface creates a warm and grounded atmosphere that complements natural materials and understated interiors.

items.name: Krishna Radha Textured Art
items.desc:
A timeless divine connection
This expressive depiction of Radha and Krishna pairs deep blue tones with warm ochre, gold, and cream. Flowing forms and bold contours highlight their divine connection, creating a devotional statement piece with a contemporary artistic character.

items.name: Ocean Layers Textured Art
items.desc:
An abstract study of sea and sand
Deep ocean blues, soft turquoise, and sandy ivory flow together in layered diagonal forms. The raised-looking surface and natural color transitions evoke the meeting of sea and shore, offering a sophisticated accent for modern interiors.

items.name: Golden Shore Textured Art
items.desc:
A warm coastal sunset
Golden sunlight spreads across the shoreline as deep teal waves meet a softly illuminated beach. Textural brushwork enhances the contrast between the sea, sand, and glowing sky, bringing the warmth of a coastal evening into your home.

items.name: Ganesha Heritage Textured Art
items.desc:
A traditional motif with a modern finish
Featuring Lord Ganesha in rich gold, charcoal, and ivory tones, this artwork blends traditional symbolism with a bold decorative composition. Its visibly layered, relief-like details give it a distinctive presence in elegant living spaces and devotional settings.

items.name: Krishna Radiance Textured Art
items.desc:
A striking portrait of Krishna
Deep blue tones and luminous saffron accents define this powerful depiction of Lord Shiva. Bold painterly marks and contrasting colors create an energetic visual impact, making this artwork a meaningful focal point for devotional and contemporary spaces.

items.name: Shiva Eternal Textured Art
items.desc:
A bold spiritual statement
This dramatic portrait of Lord Shiva combines midnight blue, fiery orange, and golden highlights with symbolic elements including the crescent moon and trident. Strong contrasts and expressive surface details evoke strength, stillness, and timeless spiritual energy.

items.name: Hanuman Divine Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A devotional watercolor portrait
Lord Hanuman is portrayed with a dignified expression, traditional ornaments, and a rich saffron palette. Loose watercolor washes and colorful splashes lend the artwork a lively, expressive character that suits a prayer room or spiritual collection.

items.name: Hanuman Textured Art
items.desc:
A tranquil mountain-inspired abstract
Muted mountain silhouettes meet earthy rust and warm ivory tones in this atmospheric landscape. Layered marks and subtle surface variation give the composition a natural, weathered character, ideal for calm and contemporary interiors.

items.name: Krishna Radha Sunset Textured Art
items.desc:
A romantic devotional landscape
Radha and Krishna sit beside a glowing river as the setting sun reflects across the water. Warm amber light, deep silhouettes, and expressive brushwork create a contemplative scene celebrating devotion, companionship, and serenity.

items.name: Hanuman Valor Textured Art
items.desc:
A powerful devotional portrait
Lord Hanuman is portrayed with a determined gaze, ornate golden crown, and vibrant saffron and amber highlights. Bold strokes and dramatic contrasts emphasize courage, devotion, and strength, creating a commanding addition to a spiritual art collection.

items.name: Shiva Serenity Watercolor Art
items.desc:
A peaceful watercolor interpretation
This serene portrayal of Lord Shiva uses cool blue washes, delicate detailing, and soft water-inspired forms to evoke calm and contemplation. Its light background and flowing composition make it well suited to meditation spaces and devotional interiors.

items.name: Golden Lotus Path Textured Art
items.desc: A large ivory lotus with golden detailing emerges from flowing, layered forms. Small golden footprints lead toward the flower, creating a symbolic composition associated with peace, purity, and spiritual growth.

items.name: Moonlit Ocean Textured Art
items.desc: A dramatic moonlit seascape with deep charcoal-blue clouds, warm golden highlights, and shimmering reflections across the water. The contrast creates a calm yet striking focal point.

items.name: Golden Moon River Textured Art
items.desc: A winding ivory river flows through deep forest-green hills beneath a luminous golden moon. Raised-looking textures and fine gold accents give this composition an elegant, contemplative feel.

items.name: Golden Mountain Dawn Textured Art
items.desc: Layered mountain peaks in warm beige and earthy brown tones rise beneath a golden sun. Textural ridges and subtle metallic-looking accents create depth and a serene natural atmosphere.

items.name: Golden Tree of Life Textured Art
items.desc: A branching tree with golden leaves spreads across a warm neutral background. Sculptural-looking branches, delicate leaf details, and a circular golden motif create a luxurious nature-inspired statement.

items.name: Ocean Wave Layers Textured Art
items.desc: Flowing layers of deep navy, teal, and ivory evoke powerful ocean waves. The contrast between dark water and pale foam gives the abstract composition movement and a refreshing coastal character.

items.name: Golden Blossom Sunset Textured Art
items.desc: A delicate flowering tree frames a glowing golden sunset above reflective water. Soft cream textures and metallic-looking golden details create a peaceful, refined landscape.

items.name: Ivory Flow Abstract Textured Art
items.desc: Organic flowing forms in ivory, cream, and sand create a minimalist abstract composition. Subtle tonal variation and layered surface details bring understated elegance to contemporary interiors.

items.name: Golden Moon Phases Textured Art
items.desc: A sequence of moon phases combines charcoal, ivory, and gold tones in a balanced celestial design. The circular forms and textured surfaces make this piece a distinctive accent for modern spaces.

items.name: Earth Tones Cracked Texture Art
items.desc: Warm terracotta, rust, taupe, and cream shapes meet in a cracked-earth-inspired abstract. Golden-looking seams emphasize the organic pattern and create a rich, earthy visual effect.

items.name: Serene Buddha Textured Art
items.desc: A peaceful Buddha portrait in muted beige and taupe is framed by a golden halo. Fine facial details, patterned hair, and layered textures give the devotional artwork a calm, meditative presence.

items.name: Golden Horizon Sunset Textured Art
items.desc: A glowing sun rests on the horizon above a softly rippled sea and layered neutral-toned shore. Golden highlights and textured strokes evoke the quiet beauty of sunset.

items.name: Golden Moon Owls Textured Art
items.desc: Two owls sit close together on a fine branch before a large golden moon and deep forest-green background. Warm neutral feathers and delicate gold accents create a serene, intimate composition.
